From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Subject: Mutual Success Plan — stakeholders & owners (draft)

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today, Amy — appreciate the clarity on latency SLAs and the pilot use case. Attached is a one-page Mutual Success Plan (MSP) draft that captures the milestones we discussed, proposed owners, and known dependencies. High level:

- Target: pilot in production (beta) by 2026-11-20.
- Key milestones: SOW sign, security review, infra onboarding, pilot run (2 weeks), final go/no-go.
- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence, network peering, test data subset, billing terms.

Please do three quick things when you get a minute:
1) Confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact at DataWorks we should engage for commercial approvals.
2) Confirm the security owner and legal owner we should loop into the evidence collection (names + emails are ideal).
3) Flag any missing milestones or hard constraints (e.g., freeze windows, procurement cycles).

I've cc'd our internal owners (Lauren, Rishi, Monica) — we'll own the Redwood-side tasks in the MSP. Attachments: Mutual_Success_Plan_v1.pdf, SOW_outline.docx.

Next step from us: update MSP with your stakeholder names and send a version for signature by 10/20 so legal/procurement can start parallel review.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

Attachment: Mutual_Success_Plan_v1.pdf (1 page summary)
Attachment: SOW_outline.docx (skeleton for commercial SOW)

Thanks, Vivek — good recap and the MSP looks like the right shape. Quick answers from our side:

- Economic buyer: Karen Chu (VP Product) — karen.chu@dataworks.com
- Procurement: procurement@datacorp.com (you already have them cc'd). Typical turnaround for MSAs + SOW review is 10 business days once we hand a draft to procurement.
- Security owner: Rajiv Patel (Head of Cloud Security) — r.patel@dataworks.com
- Legal owner: Elena Gomez (Senior Counsel) — e.gomez@dataworks.com
- Eng lead for pilot: Marco Ruiz (Platform Manager) — m.ruiz@dataworks.com

Two notes:
- Rajiv asked us to confirm whether Redwood can supply SOC2 Type II summary and network peering checklist by 10/19 — that's a blocker for their security kickoff.
- Procurement will want the SOW with explicit termination and data residency clauses up front; I flagged the SOW_outline.docx to them.

If you can incorporate the owners and the two items above into v2, I will route to Karen + procurement for approval.

On numbers: Karen is the EBuyer; she will need an internal ROI line (I can work with your solutions team if you want a 1-pager).

— Amy

amy@dataworks.com

Thanks Amy — good clarity on the DataWorks side. A few quick confirmations from Redwood on owners and immediate action items:

- Redwood security owner (point of contact for evidence collection & architecture review): Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com). I'll ask Monica to start assembling the SOC2 summary + network peering checklist; target handoff 2026-10-19.
- Redwood legal owner for contractual redlines: Lauren Bishop (lauren_bishop@redwood.com). She can take first pass on termination/data-residency clauses and will aim to turn a redline back in ~5 business days once procurement engages.
- Redwood eng lead for pilot: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwood.com) — I'll coordinate infra details and provide a test-data checklist to Marco.

Proposed RACI (high-level):
- Economic buyer: DataWorks (Karen Chu) — Accountable for purchase approval.
- Procurement & Legal: DataWorks legal/procurement (Elena/Procurement) — Responsible for contract sign.
- Security review: DataWorks (Rajiv) — Responsible for risk acceptance; Redwood (Monica) provides artifacts.
- Implementation/eng run: DataWorks (Marco) + Redwood (Rishi) — Responsible & Doer.

I will open a shared Google folder and drop the SOC2 summary + peering checklist by COB 10/19. Vivek — can you confirm the expected pilot SLA (p95 latency target) in the MSP text so we can include an acceptance criteria bullet? Also confirm whether procurement requires a vendor questionnaire before legal starts.

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
